Name: Chocolatte's Floral Wallpaper and Furniture
Author: chocolatte12
Description:
Adds 7 different floral wallpapers. They have the options of baseboards, panels, dark wood, and white wood, making 28 variations.

It also adds floral furniture in green, pink, and blue.

Catalogue can be bought from Robin's for 10 000g.

Compatible with Happy Home Designer.
